items.original: Spandana Sphoorty Financial reported consolidated Q2 profit of Rs 18 crore, reversing a Rs 249 crore year-ago loss. Assets under management grew 31% to Rs 5,364 crore, while improving asset quality reduced gross and net NPAs.

items.headline: Bank of Baroda Q2 profit jumps 36% to Rs 6,532 crore on NSE stake sale
items.original: Bank of Baroda reported 36% year-on-year profit growth to Rs 6,532 crore in Q2FY27, boosted by NSE stake sale gains and higher interest income. The lender raised annual credit and deposit growth guidance amid strong loan demand.

items.headline: US Markets: Marriott International shares in focus ahead of Q3 earnings, growth outlook amid Iran war impact
items.original: Analysts expect Marriott to report earnings per share (EPS) of $2.87 for the third quarter, an increase of 16.2% from $2.47 recorded in the corresponding quarter last year

items.headline: Record earnings! 5 big takeaways from RIL Q2 results investors should watch for Monday trading
items.original: Reliance Industries reported record Q2FY27 profit of Rs 29,550 crore and revenue of Rs 3.62 lakh crore, driven by strong refining margins and Jio growth. Retail profitability weakened, while declining debt improved the conglomerate's financial position.

items.headline: Vijay Kedia's portfolio stock under ₹150: This textile stock adds ₹3.7 crore to his wealth since IPO; Do you own?

items.headline: Silver price crash deepens as Oct losses hit ₹45,000/kg; gold falls to 7-month low: Why are precious metals sinking?
items.original: Silver fell another ₹10,577 per kg on Friday, extending its October decline to ₹45,000 and putting it on track for its steepest monthly loss of 2026.
